author: Euromar S.A.
text: We're heading to Shanghai for CIIE 2026. Euromar S.A is joining Xibarita at their booth during the China International Import Expo, bringing Argentine wild red shrimp, squid, hake and marine ingredients — wild-caught and frozen at source, as we've been doing since 1975.

author: Euromar S.A.
event: Seafood Show Latin America · São Paulo
text: Esta semana Euromar S.A participó de Seafood Show Latin America en São Paulo. Fue un gusto reencontrarnos con clientes y amigos en el mayor mercado de seafood de Latinoamérica.

author: Luciano Gulminelli
text: Back from World Seafood Shanghai. Three days of meetings with importers, distributors and processors, and one clear takeaway: there is real appetite in China for South American seafood, and still a lot of room to grow.

author: Luciano Gulminelli
text: Three days at Seafood Expo Global in Barcelona. Euromar is a family company with a long history in the Argentine fishing business — the kind of place where the relationships go back decades.
